content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in McKinney

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: PMI requires a combination of formal education and verifiable project-management experience. Review PMI's secondary degree and experience thresholds—or bachelor's degree with reduced experience hours—before applying. Granite PM Academy advisors can clarify which track fits your background.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours of Instruction
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual PMP Bootcamp, delivered by active certified practitioners. The instructor-led format covers the PMBOK® Guide framework, exam domains, and real-world applications. Attend synchronously on your schedule—no travel required from McKinney.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After completing your bootcamp, submit your PMP credential application to PMI with proof of education and project experience. Pay PMI's exam fee at application. Granite PM Academy staff will guide you through the submission process and answer questions about documentation.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Sit for the Exam
steps_items.text: Access Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources, including practice exams, study guides, and instructor office hours. Schedule your computer-based exam through Pearson VUE at a testing center or remotely. Our support team remains available to address final study questions.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your PMP Credential
steps_items.text: After passing, you'll earn the PMP mark and begin your 3-year renewal cycle. Maintain your credential by earning professional development units (PDUs) through PMI-recognized training, certifications, or project experience. Plan ahead to meet PMI's renewal requirements before your cycle closes.
